name: Cherry boy Innocent girl
source:
Main character got used to bullying from different girls during his school years. Sometimes they even tease him enjoying his reaction. This is a story about difficult relations with such girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在学生时代早已习惯遭到不同女生欺负。她们有时甚至会故意逗弄他，以他的反应取乐。这是一个讲述他与这类女生之间复杂关系的故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
